visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a high-definition time-lapse of the night sky, where the Milky Way's galactic core is visibly stretching across the frame with millions of shimmering stars. Below, a dark shoreline meets the black sea under a clear sky. Yellow traditional Chinese subtitles are centered at the bottom. (2) The scene transitions to a brilliant moonrise over the ocean surface. A bright lunar disc emerges from the horizon, casting a strong, shimmering orange reflection across the moving water while dark clouds drift rapidly across the frame in a time-lapse sequence. (3) A silhouette of a man is seen sitting on a rock in the foreground, facing the vast ocean during a purple-hued dawn. The sky changes from deep violet to a soft blue-grey as fast-moving clouds pass over the distant horizon and breaking waves. (4) In the final phase, the video switches to real-time footage of a man in a light grey t-shirt and dark pants sitting down in a black foldable camping chair. He is in a gravel-paved outdoor area with trees and small structures, leaning back to relax.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The background consists of a vast ocean coastline, a starry night sky with the Milky Way, and a gravel-covered campsite with lush green trees and outdoor lighting fixtures.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the high-frequency chirping of nocturnal insects, creating a serene outdoor atmosphere. There is no music or speech present. (2) A subtle whoosh transition effect introduces a calm, ambient lo-fi music track with a soft electronic beat. The natural insect sounds remain as a secondary layer in the mix. (3) A low-frequency rumble of ocean waves crashing is layered into the soundscape, adding depth to the nature-based recording. A soft metallic hit sound effect provides a rhythmic transition between visual scenes. (4) Real-world incidental sounds of a person walking on gravel and the rustling of a synthetic folding chair are heard as the man sits down, concluding with a soft thud against the chair frame.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to showcase the breathtaking natural beauty of a remote coastal location in Taiwan through professional time-lapse photography of the Milky Way and lunar events, eventually transitioning to a lifestyle vlog moment of relaxation to evoke a sense of peace and wonder.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The combination of high-quality time-lapse imagery and natural ASMR sounds makes this video highly immersive for nature lovers.
